decisions.reason: Requiring an NFT image in a wallet view does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
Wallet NFT image rendering does not alter dashboard commission visibility or accounting.
Wallet NFT image rendering does not change the requirement to display awarded ticket counts in the dashboard.
The source adds wallet image rendering but does not change the candidate's existing referral-code, ticket-counter, badge, or ebook-access metadata attributes.
NFT image visibility in a wallet is independent of the public sales countdown for the next prize draw.
The wallet rendering requirement does not alter the counting basis for public mint statistics.
The source contains no decision to revise About-page copy or presentation.
The wallet image problem does not necessarily change any current FAQ explanation.
Rendering the NFT image in a wallet does not change the confirmation email's contents, certificate actions, or reader link.
The wallet NFT image is a different rendering context from the landing-page book cover.
The wallet rendering requirement does not alter the landing-page hero layout or its controls.
NFT image rendering in wallet views does not change referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, or payout behavior.
